scripts.build: npm run guard && npm run build -w @wc/core-native && npm run generate && npm run build -w @wc/shared && npm run build -w @wc/server && npm run build -w @wc/client
scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @wc/server & npm run dev -w @wc/client
scripts.test: npm run test:rust && npm run test:ts
scripts.test:ts: npm run test -w @wc/shared && npm run test -w @wc/server && npm run test -w @wc/client
scripts.fuzz: cargo build --release && cargo test --release -p wc-core --test fuzz -- --nocapture
scripts.typecheck: npm run guard && npm run generate -- --check && tsc -b packages/shared packages/server packages/client
